layers.name: Lstm
layers.doc: Stacked batch-first long short-term memory using whole-sequence composed scans.
layers.adaptation: No fused C++ donor kernel exists for LSTM. Rust composes each timestep from recorded linear and elementwise dispatches in input/forget/candidate/output gate order, retaining checked FP32 geometry, deterministic seeded host initialization, versioned parameter adjoints and optional unregistered zero biases; a fused scan kernel remains planned performance work
